scope: Default hosted product route exposes only authenticated human 1v1. CPU play remains available solely through the explicit diagnostic-cpu switch and cannot leak back into a normal session.
productAssertions: the CPU control is hidden on the normal product URL
the relay rejects attempts to enable CPU in a tournament room
a missing relay fails closed instead of starting a local CPU match
session storage records diagnostic scope and a normal URL refuses to resume a diagnostic CPU room
the existing O-button product guard remains on character select instead of entering another native mode
diagnostic: ?diagnostic-cpu=1 creates a separately scoped CPU room for development probes; the switch is not linked or exposed by the normal product UI.
